text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sinto que Taiki Shuttle e eu formamos<n>um vínculo
insubstituível durante este<n>tempo juntos.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdyyy, Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You should've seen the look on your<n>face! Guess
my little surprise was a<n>success!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I knew ya wouldn't expect me<n>outside of training
hours...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I sped on over when your guard<n>was down,
and—bang! Bull's-eye!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew... Job well done, if I do say so<n>myself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Is that really all she came here to do?<n>I ask if she
has another reason for<n>visiting...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: As a matter of fact, I do! I wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh... What was it again?
choice_data_list: Maybe you ran so fast, it fell out of your head.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, ya know how it goes! I'll<n>just ask ya when
it comes back to<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, since I'm here... How about<n>gettin' an
early start on training?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My debut's right around the corner,<n>so don't try
and stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle drags me to the track,<n>with our training
session starting well<n>ahead of schedule...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hm-hmm, I'm on my way... Me<n>and Trainer
off to the racetrack... ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, who's that I spy over there?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy there, Air Groooove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You again, Taiki? How many times<n>do I have to tell
you not to tackle me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Sorry 'bout that! You never<n>seem to budge,
so I can't resist<n>tryin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Guess I gotta give it a bit more oomph<n>next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You just don't know when to quit, do<n>you?! You've
got some nerve...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... At any rate, have you settledeverything with your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you've got permission, let's get<n>started.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Right... Permission. Uh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you've forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to be moving all the<n>Umamusume
of the Year resources<n>over to the library!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You said you needed to ask your<n>trainer to adjust
your training<n>schedule first and ran off!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, so that's what it was! It's all<n>comin' back to
me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's because I just explained<n>everything to you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel a little bad leaving things this<n>way, so I
decide to lend a helping<n>hand.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! There're more papers here<n>than ya can
shake a stick at! Even<n>with all three of us, we're
nowhere<n>near finished!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Considering they concern every<n>single
Umamusume of the Year since<n>the title's inception,
it's<n>understandable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
These materials contain not only their<n>individual
performance records, but<n>detailed accounts of their
training<n>regimens and opponents as well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be darned! That's those<n>Umamusume of
the Year for ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...What exactly is an "Umamusume of<n>the Year,"
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You don't even know that?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... Every year, a select<n>number of runners
from the Twinkle<n>Series are bestowed a URA award
to<n>commemorate their outstanding<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The awards are divided into several<n>divisions,
including one for<n>classic-year runners, as well as
others for sprints and dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But only a single runner—one whose<n>efforts
outshine all the others—can<n>receive the honor of
Umamusume of<n>the Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So basically... we're talkin' about<n>a super
amazing Umamusume here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the title has historically<n>gone to
powerhouses with<n>overwhelming talent... but that's
not<n>the whole story.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whaddya mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The winners are preserved here in<n>writing, their
names passed down for<n>generations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The stage of the Twinkle Series<n>dazzles with tales
of past greats, ever<n>woven into its history.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mesmerized by its glamor, everyone<n>longs to stand
on its turf.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To become a presence that ignites a<n>burning
passion into the hearts of<n>others—that's what it
means to be an<n>Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish collating the materials,<n>Taiki and I
head out to train...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Guess what! I heard resources about<n>all the
previous Umamusume of the<n>Year have been added
to the library!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What, seriously? We should go have<n>a look, like,
right now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you all about who inspired me<n>to get into
running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What a nice smile that was. Shinin'<n>so bright.
choice_data_list: That was the face of a dreamer.
That was the face of a dreamer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You said it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just by steppin' on the track, you can<n>find your
dream...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And nothing makes us Umamusume<n>or our fans
happier!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, that settles it! I know what I<n>gotta do!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become Umamusume of<n>the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I never expected to hear these words.<n>It's a
statement that could easily be<n>mistaken for any one
of her usual<n>offbeat remarks.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But the glint in Taiki Shuttle's eyes<n>tells me
otherwise. This time, she's<n>serious.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can see it now—fantastic races, great
performances!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's what I wanna show<n>everybody...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Everybody bein' my peers, fans,family, and friends! Everybody Iknow, and everybody I ever willknow!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make every single last<n>one of 'em as
happy as possible!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's fiery passion burns bright...<n>and I won't shy
away from it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah! I'm markin' the title of<n>Umamusume of the
Year as my new<n>target!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With a grand dream in her sights,<n>Taiki Shuttle takes
her very first step<n>forward!
